catalog.name: entity:hr.job
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Job Position (hr.job).

fields.name: expected_employees
fields.help: Expected number of employees for this job position after new recruitment.

fields.name: no_of_employee
fields.help: Number of employees currently occupying this job position.

fields.name: no_of_recruitment
fields.help: Number of new employees you expect to recruit.

fields.name: user_id
fields.help: The Recruiter will be the default value for all Applicants in this job             position. The Recruiter is automatically added to all meetings with the Applicant.

fields.name: address_id
fields.help: Select the location where the applicant will work. Addresses listed here are defined on the company's contact information.

fields.name: open_application_count
fields.help: Number of applications that are still ongoing (not hired or refused)

fields.name: new_application_count
fields.help: Number of applications that are new in the flow (typically at first step of the flow)

fields.name: alias_id
fields.help: Email alias for this job position. New emails will automatically create new applicants for this job position.

fields.name: interviewer_ids
fields.help: The Interviewers set on the job position can see all Applicants in it. They have access to the information, the attachments, the meeting management and they can refuse him. You don't need to have Recruitment rights to be set as an interviewer.

fields.name: no_of_hired_employee
fields.help: Number of hired employees for this job position during recruitment phase.

fields.name: survey_id
fields.help: Choose an interview form for this job position and you will be able to print/answer this interview from all applicants who apply for this job

fields.name: website_published
fields.help: Set if the application is published on the website of the company.

fields.name: job_details
fields.help: Complementary information that will appear on the job submission page

constraints.name: _name_company_uniq
constraints.message: The name of the job position must be unique per department in company!

constraints.name: _no_of_recruitment_positive
constraints.message: The expected number of new employees must be positive.

definitions.documentation: We don't want the current user to be follower of all created job

fields.name: description
fields.placeholder: e.g. Summarize the position in one or two lines...
